stem.text: A nucleus of neptunium-236 contains 93 protons and 143 neutrons. This nucleus decays with the emission of an $\alpha$-particle. The nucleus formed then emits a $\beta^{-}$ particle.
Which diagram shows the changes in the number $P$ of protons and the number $N$ of neutrons in these nuclei?
